snippet.title: Collie Call: Farm Of Tomorrow | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #CollieCallfarmoftomorrow

🐶Collie Call: Farm Of Tomorrow Launch Trailer🐶
🐑Available for Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4, Playstation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Microsoft Store!

In Collie Call: Farm of Tomorrow, you’re back as the smartest pup on the pasture, but this time, the farm’s gone full sci-fi! With teleporters, conveyor belts, oil slicks, and sneaky holes, you’ll need all your brainpower (and tail-wagging determination) !

KEY FEATURES:
﻿🐑Grid-based puzzles with futuristic farm gadgets;
🐑Undo and restart anytime;
🐑3 themed worlds: Winter, Halloween, and Spring;
🐑30 handcrafted puzzles;

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
🐶Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/collie-call-farm-of-tomorrow-switch/
🐶Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015313/
🐶Xbox Series X|S: http://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/collie-call-farm-of-tomorrow/9PLW90QGFQMQ/0010
🐶Xbox One: http://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/collie-call-farm-of-tomorrow-xbox-one/9P8S1SQVC17X/0010
🐶Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n4h75c69pmt?hl=pt-BR&gl=BR
